messages:
Lee (Product): Need a compact plan for EU onramp: customer wants data residency, audit exports, and ~50ms p50. Propose three tactical paths: Shield (dedicated), Affinity (steering), Pilot-Shield (one-customer shield + affinity). Short takes?

Nina (Infra): Shield = provision in-region pools + KMS attestation; Affinity = steer-to-edge with fallback; Pilot-Shield = fastest commercial path but double ops.

Ravi (Architecture): For each path we should list hard gates: provisioning automation, p50/p99 targets, fallback contract, and model-variant compatibility checks.

Priya (SRE): Ops gates: canary with rollback, eviction runbook for noisy tenants, per-tenant telemetry. Recommend canary window 48h with staged ramp.

Dan (Sales): Customer will pay for shield pilot. They want an 8-week pilot timeline and an InfoSec one-pager.

Marta (CustSuccess): Pilot acceptance: synthetic latency probes, audit-export verification, KMS key attest report. I'll own acceptance criteria.

Lee (Product): Quick tradeoff bullets I pasted:
- Shield: Pros: deterministic latency & clean audit; Cons: cost + 6-9w lead time. Gates: autoscale test, KMS, audit export validated.
- Affinity: Pros: fast onboard + cheaper; Cons: potential noisy neighbors. Gates: fallback <300ms added, telemetry for misroutes.
- Pilot-Shield: Pros: revenue & compliance for pilot; Cons: complexity. Gates: shield gating for pilot customer + affinity gating for org.

Ravi (Architecture): Tiny sample policy snippet for infra scoping:
```
policy eu_onramp {
  when region=="eu" {
    if tenant.plan=="shield" -> pool("eu-shield")
    else -> prefer(pool("eu-affinity"))
  }
  fallback -> pool("global-shared")
}
```

Nina (Infra): Rough dev estimates: Shield 8-10w (provisioning + ops), Affinity 3-4w (routing + telemetry), Pilot-Shield 6-8w (plus billing). Assumes reuse of autoscaler/pool API.

Priya (SRE): Performance acceptance thresholds suggestion:
- p50 (edge->endpoint) < 50ms for shield
- p99 tail < 250ms for shield
- Canary ramp 0->10->50->100 over 48h with error budget <0.01%

Dan (Sales): I'll confirm pilot customer and legal contacts. Need one-pager for InfoSec by end of week.

Marta (CustSuccess): I'll draft the acceptance test plan and share with the customer.

Lee (Product): Action items:
- Nina: add cost + ops tasks to RFC by Wed (ack?)
- Ravi: short spike on model-variant parity for fallbacks (1w)
- Priya: SRE checklist + runbook links
- Dan/Marta: confirm pilot customer and InfoSec contacts

sec-bot: Reminder: attach security checklist template at /templates/security-onramp.md.

Lee (Product): If no objections I'll file the RFC Thursday and prioritize Pilot-Shield for Q planning. :white_check_mark:
